viewports.name: desktop
checks: fixed confirm action is reachable on empty and full-canvas masks
lasso unions disconnected masks and Shift/Control/Meta modifiers add and subtract
outside touch tap clears; outside drag adds without a modifier
color-selection touch tap outside clears after its threshold is passed
confirming a moved selection commits the pixels and clears its mask as one undoable action
touch and Shift lasso add to a pending moved polygon, with one pixel undo
virtual cursor selects lasso cells and canceled pointer restores the previous mask
offscreen raw pointer delta keeps the move pending and pinch zoom leaves artwork unchanged
exact palette change survives one-undo/redo and saved-PXD round-trip
color adjustment selection preview cancels exactly, applies once, undoes/redoes, and round-trips saved PXD
color adjustment can apply across every existing frame and layer
Japanese text system fallback, lazy font, clipping, binary edge coverage, cancel/apply, undo/redo, and saved-PXD round-trip
